_comment: Easter collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. Requested by name: Togepi line as Easter eggs, Lopunny line as the Easter rabbit. The other 16 were picked with `generate.py pick --count 16 --seed easter-2027` (random lines no other collection uses).

readme.title: Easter
readme.summary: An Easter egg, the Easter Bunny, and a Pastel look for the rest.
looks: Pastel: every colour turned to its soft pastel version, a painted zigzag ribbon and little spring daisies
shiny: chocolate with rainbow candy sprinkles
